example: The company switched to sustainable packaging last year.
note: Ключове слово IELTS-есе про довкілля. Часта колокація: sustainable development, sustainable practices.

example: Carbon emissions have risen sharply over the past decade.
note: Майже завжди у виразі carbon emissions / greenhouse gas emissions.

example: Air pollution is a major problem in big cities.
note: Незлічуваний іменник — без артикля «a» і без множини.

example: Deforestation threatens biodiversity across the region.
note: Часто в парі з дієсловом threaten або preserve.

example: Coral reefs support a fragile ecosystem.
The government is investing heavily in renewable energy.
Many countries still rely on fossil fuels for electricity.
note: Завжди два слова разом, часто у множині: fossil fuels.

example: Deforestation is one of the leading causes of climate change.
The park was created for wildlife conservation.
Rising temperatures are destroying the polar bear's habitat.
The region has suffered from severe drought for three years.
Carbon dioxide is the most common greenhouse gas.
We recycle paper, glass, and plastic at home.
The factory produces a lot of industrial waste.
Chemical runoff contaminated the local water supply.
note: Сильніше за «pollute» — часто про воду/їжу з небезпечним ефектом.

example: Ozone depletion was a major concern in the 1990s.
Flying frequently increases your carbon footprint significantly.
note: Дуже поширений вираз у IELTS Writing Task 2 про довкілля.

example: Several endangered species live in this national park.
Coastal erosion is destroying beaches around the world.
Rapid urbanization has put pressure on natural resources.
Governments must act quickly to mitigate climate change.
note: Дуже частотне у формальних текстах про політику й довкілля.

example: Reducing meat consumption can lower your environmental impact.
The factory released toxic chemicals into the river.
Stricter environmental regulations were introduced last year.
The company aims to reduce its environmental footprint.
note: У переносному сенсі — «вплив», не тільки слід на землі.
